items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Walter Prustin, George Boyd, Chester's artist, Lil' Chinese, and myself. You see, them times, no saxophone.

ctx.x: I think that's all. Who was the band? George Boyd. That's kind of one. See, that's how we left Jack. Them black guys pushed me up, you know, to get up our own band. That's how we left Jack. We're all left together. Walter Prustin, George Boyd, Chester's artist, Lil' Chinese, and myself. You see, them times, no saxophone.
